gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly identifies the transpose-orientation mismatch in the proposition and induction: the stated relation requires the transposed Gramian, while the proof uses the opposite orientation, so the induction and resulting update do not follow. Its specific repair propagates the correct transpose orientations.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the same failed induction for the claimed orthogonal equivalence: the proposition uses A_t=P_t bar(A_t)Q_t^top, equivalently bar(A_t)=P_t^top A_t Q_t, but the proof uses P_t(sum_i A_{t,i}A_{t,i}^top)P_t^top instead of the required P_t^top(sum_i A_{t,i}A_{t,i}^top)P_t, invalidating the ensuing update identity.

component_coverage.gold_component: The proof of the proposition uses the wrong transpose orientation for the transformed left Gramian and therefore cannot derive the claimed induction/update identities.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 states the proposition's and proof's incompatible orientations, explains that the induction does not close, and gives the corrected transpose-oriented induction and update. This independently and fully diagnoses the gold defect.
